newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends at highs but barely firmer.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends at highs but barely firmer.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures ended a dull session at the highs, buoyed by speculative short-covering and a dearth of selling, floor sources said.
Dealers said that besides some follow-through short covering and position-squaring, activity is likely to remain dull and confined to its current range ahead of Thursday's Thanksgiving holiday.
CSCE world sugar futures will not trade Thursday and Friday due to the U.S. holiday.
Nearby resistance in March was seen at 10.71, the high made Friday. Support was pegged at a gap in the charts between 10.50 and 10.48 in March.
The spot-March contract ended 0.04 higher at 10.69, having ranged from 10.69 to 10.58. May closed 0.03 higher at 10.75, while the deferred contracts settled 0.05 to 0.03 higher.
Volume was estimated at only 6,072 lots.
